honesty_statement: Real-time backtest: at every origin the models see only provider vintages whose evidenced, conservative availability instant is at or before the origin (available_then reconstruction; REVA did not exist at these origins). Outcomes are first releases from later vintages. Derived models use only past errors whose outcome was published at their origin. Not financial advice.
label: real_time_vintage_backtest
